title: Roll the Dice
author: Claude
blurb: One short level about chance. A die sits on the ground, rolling: it is a ring of six blocks that each turn into the next after a few ticks. Mara walks into it and it stops on the face it shows, handing over a gold key for an odd face or a silver key for an even one. A wall ahead has a gold door on the ground and a silver door up a ladder, so the face picks the door. Signs in the level say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and change how long a face shows.

box.back: A small explorer in a green beanie finds a die rolling on the ground. Touch it and it stops, and the face it shows hands over a key: gold for odd, silver for even. Two doors wait ahead, one for each key. The game has no random number: the tick decides the roll. Play, then open the game in Game-Maker and change how long a face shows.
features: A ring of six blocks that turn into one another, like a die rolling
A touch that stops the die on the face it shows
Made to be copied and taken apart
